layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: ice-age folk of the frozen mountain peaks, calm and friendly. Their fixed colours: shaggy warm white and cream fur shaded with soft blue-grey, dark slate blue-grey skin, dark brown-grey hide and furs, pale ivory bone, and exactly one accent colour, a bright glacier ice blue with white highlights, only as small ice crystals, frost and ice shards.

layers.text: Subject: Yeti, a chunky cute snow ape, broad and upright, with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a short wide body covered in shaggy fur, long strong arms with big dark slate hands and short legs with big dark slate feet: a dark slate blue-grey face with small bright friendly eyes, a wide mouth with two small white fangs and shaggy fur framing the face; one big chunky club of pale ivory bone crusted with ice crystals held in one hand; simple shapes and very few details; clearly an ape, not a person in furs.
